title: Milestones read off the data: reached from what they rest on, ahead from what is halted or needed
note: Half is done (2026-11-13): what a milestone has reached is counted from the items it rests on, in the purpose lens. The other half: the lens of insight holds what is halted and what is needed as rows - a halt with no milestone naming its end is a milestone waiting to be seen. The author: a milestone is praise of work done, or of work ahead that fills a gap; it should be discovered from the data, not placed from our heads.

title: The lab's own record of what happens, read through a lens: what is being done now
note: oco-agent keeps a journal (every job: submitted, claimed, finished, by whom, when), beats (who is here) and what was said, as tables declared the way a lens declares them - in a folder that is not a place. To try: mark it, and let a lens read what is claimed and not finished. What it shows decides what follows; the friction expected is that lenses are built into ocoeco and cannot be given by a place.

title: Signs, needs and milestones as one: a sign points at a need; a need is met when what was lacking is seen, and how it fits; a milestone is that, praised
note: Today the lens holds a problem and a countermeasure in prose. To become: a sign with its kind (stale, overlapping, lacking, unclear) and where it points; ended by a link to what changed the whole. Signs that are derived stay as they are - they are already this: shown while true, gone when the whole fits. The four things the week's seventeen point at are the first to take up: a change on the lab as one act; what is observed kept apart from where work lands; readiness named as the rung it is; a link chosen among what exists rather than typed. 2026-11-13, the author: what a connection says in prose can be entered as intelligible data - relations between a need, a decision made to fill another need, a need that fills a gap, a need that clarifies an overlap; and a need in general always seems to be a need for clarity. So three things kept apart are one with different faces: a sign with its kind (stale, overlapping, lacking, unclear) is how a need shows; X needed Y is a need named between two things; a milestone ahead is a need met, praised. What was written as three records and a practice being one sign was the need those signs point at. It becomes one piece of work with milestones-read-off-the-data. Held to the test used so far: a row is made where something is then read off it; where nothing would be, words stay. 2026-11-13, the author, setting a phrase right: a whole is not changing - a whole is always a whole; we discover it, how what is in it fits together; and what is lacking, a gap, is something we do not yet see in the whole and how it relates inside it. So a need is not met by what changed the whole, as was written here, but when what was lacking is seen.
